title: Be Super Specific
goal: A fuzzy ask gets a fuzzy answer. Add details!
mascot_lines: Helpers do their best when we use specific words.
If you say 'make it nice', the helper has to guess what 'nice' means.
But if you say 'make the button big and blue', now it knows exactly what you want.
Numbers, names, and clear words turn vague ideas into real answers.

tier2.rephrase: Pick the message that has the most clear details.

tier3.nudge: Look for size, color, and special parts. More words = clearer picture.
